transcript: Hey.  Hi, my name is Ralston Raphael.  What do you build for CPSC for  15 this semester.
answer: For CPSC 415, Ralston built two shipped projects: a team web app that generates labeled science diagrams and checks them with vision models against a handwritten checklist, and a command-line receipt reader that uses a vision model for extraction and plain-code arithmetic checks for the totals.
